openpinn_plate.problem_text:
Plate with circular hole, 2D plane-stress linear elasticity (agent-assisted PINN workflow, Sec. 5.3).
Geometry: Square plate [0,2]^2 m with a circular hole of radius 0.25 m centred at (1,1) m; 2D plane stress
Material: Isotropic linear elastic (not hyperelastic), plane stress, E = 210 GPa, nu = 0.3
Boundary conditions: Left edge fixed (ux = uy = 0); top, bottom and hole edges traction-free; right edge carries the applied traction
Loading: Uniform uniaxial traction of 1 MPa on the right edge; other outer edges and the hole boundary traction-free
Discretisation in the paper: Plain PINN: tanh MLP, width 64, depth 4 (raised from the planned depth 3), strong-form residual via automatic differentiation. Stage 1: 10000 Adam steps with 512 interior + 128 boundary points resampled each step (SI units, then nondimensionalised with L = 1 m, S = 1e6 Pa, U = SL/E). Stage 2: 260 L-BFGS outer steps on a fixed batch of 2048 interior + 512 boundary points. Learning rate, float precision of the final runs and the FEM element type are not given.
Features: Corners (0,0) and (0,2), where the fixed left edge meets the traction-free top and bottom edges. Stress there is singular or near-singular, so pointwise stress and the stress relative L2 near these corners may converge slowly. The hole is smooth: it concentrates stress but is not singular..
Question: which of these quantities can serve as trustworthy reference values: Final total loss (SI Adam run) (Final total PINN training loss after 10000 Adam steps in SI units); PDE residual RMSE (SI Adam run) (RMSE of the strong-form equilibrium residual); Traction-boundary RMSEs (SI Adam run) (RMSE of the traction boundary residuals); Displacement magnitude, SI prediction vs FEM (Order of magnitude of predicted vs FEM displacements); Displacement relative L2 error (SI Adam) (Relative L2 error of displacement against the FEM reference on the h = 0.025 probe mesh); Displacement relative L2 error (nondimensional Adam, 3 seeds) (Relative L2 error of displacement against the held-out FEM probe mesh (h = 0.025)); Displacement relative L2 error (L-BFGS, seed 0) (Relative L2 error of displacement after the L-BFGS continuation, on the FEM probe mesh and on a shifted held-out probe set); Displacement relative L2 error (L-BFGS, seeds 1 and 2) (Relative L2 error of displacement on the FEM probe mesh); Stress relative L2 error (seed 0) (Relative L2 error of the stress field against FEM); Nondimensional x-momentum residual RMSE (seed 0) (RMSE of the nondimensional x-momentum equilibrium residual)?

card.title: Open-hole composite lamina (AS4/3501-6, plane stress, elliptical planform with central hole) – range and validity of predictions over a set of constitutive laws

geometry.value: 2D plane-stress unidirectional lamina with an elliptical planform, semi-axes 50 mm and 10 mm, thickness 1 mm, central circular hole of radius 3 mm; fibres at 15° to the long axis.
geometry.quote: elliptical planform with semi-axes 50 mm and 10 mm, thickness 1 mm and a central hole of radius 3 mm

material.value: AS4/3501-6 unidirectional lamina. Reference law psi_ref is linear orthotropic with the moduli of ref. [49] (values not given in the section). Synthetic data come from a nonlinear law psi† fitted to the shear and transverse-compression curves of [49]; its nonlinear part is 40% of the shear strain at failure. The unknown energy psi(e11,e22,gamma12) is restricted to the strain box Omega_c = [-1.175,1.38]% x [-2.0,0.436]% x [-2,2]% and must be even in shear, have a natural state at zero strain and be convex on Omega_c.
material.quote: The reference ψref is the linear orthotropic law with the moduli of [49].

boundary_conditions.value: The boundary carries self-equilibrated tractions (see loading). Three displacement components at the hole are fixed to remove rigid-body motions. The section does not say which nodes or components are fixed.
boundary_conditions.quote: three displacement components at the hole are fixed to remove the rigid motions of the balanced load

loading.value: Boundary tractions of a homogeneous uniaxial stress along the long axis with resultant P. The load is normalised by PD = 1792 N, the load at which the plate with law psi† first reaches the boundary of Omega_c. Results are reported at 0.6PD (Table 6), at 0.8PD (validity and coupon acquisition), over the load path (Fig. 10a), and at 0.3PD = 537.6 N for the certificate.
loading.quote: The boundary tractions are those of a homogeneous uniaxial stress along the long axis with resultant P

discretisation.value: 4096 isoparametric quadratic triangles (P2) on a mapped mesh with 64 divisions around the hole and 32 radially, graded towards the hole; 8320 nodes; 7-point degree-5 quadrature (28 672 quadrature points). The law space uses polynomials of total degree at most 14 in the scaled strains (dimension 680). The section studies only the law-space degree (10/14/16), not the mesh.
discretisation.quote: The plate is discretised by 4096 isoparametric quadratic triangles on a mapped mesh with 64 divisions around the hole and 32 radially, graded towards the hole (8320 nodes)

reference.quote: The plate is discretised by 4096 isoparametric quadratic triangles on a mapped mesh with 64 divisions around the hole and 32 radially, graded towards the hole (8320 nodes)

qois.definition: Width of the first-order range of the secant compliance over the data-consistent set of laws, in per cent of its value
qois.reported_value: 6.19% without convexity, 3.18% with convexity (6.2% / 3.2% in text); 6.09% with four times as many readings; K/2: 5.45, 2K: 6.69, tolerance 0.1%: 4.45; law degree 10/14/16: 5.38/6.19/6.49 (not converged in degree)
qois.quote: The secant compliance is predicted within a range of 6.2% without and 3.2% with the convexity condition

qois.definition: End points of the compliance range computed with convex extreme laws followed along the load path, compared with first-order values
qois.quote: give 6.927 × 10−5 and 7.153 × 10−5 mm/N against the linear

qois.definition: Width of the first-order range of the mean shear strain in the zone around the hole, in % of value (zone extent not defined)
qois.quote: mean shear strain, hole zone

qois.name: Range of mean transverse strain, hole zone, at 0.6PD
qois.definition: Width of the first-order range of the mean transverse strain in the zone around the hole, in % of value
qois.quote: The mean transverse strain in the zone around the hole has a range larger than its value.

qois.name: Range of mean shear strain, far field, at 0.6PD
qois.definition: Width of the first-order range of the mean far-field shear strain, in % of value
qois.quote: mean shear strain, far field

qois.name: Worst-case usage of the strain domain
qois.definition: Largest first-order ratio over the fibre of any strain component at any point of the plate to its bound in Omega_c; the prediction is valid while this is below 1
qois.reported_value: Reaches 1 at 0.70PD (binding: transverse strain at hole edge); 1.29 at 0.8PD; 1.15 with an added 15° coupon; 0.84 with a 40° coupon (optimum)
qois.quote: At 0.8PD the usage is 1.29 and the prediction is not valid.

qois.name: Compliance range with an added 15° off-axis coupon at 0.8PD
qois.definition: Width of the secant-compliance range for the outcome generated by psi† after adding one off-axis coupon
qois.quote: reduces the range of the compliance most, from 7.3% to 4.6%

qois.quote: The load is referred to PD = 1792 N

qois.definition: First-order estimate of the load limit of the prior set without data
qois.quote: a first-order estimate places the limit of the prior set at 5% of PD

qois.name: Norms and radii of the law set
qois.definition: Sobolev-5 norm distances and radii that define the prior
qois.quote: The fibre is non-empty, with Kmin = 16.5 from Proposition 1

qois.definition: Smallest certified margin per parent box of the declared cell (Table 7)
qois.reported_value: All 43 pieces accepted; smallest margins from 4.52e-7 (parent 6) to 3.60e-5 (parent 7)
qois.quote: All 43 pieces are accepted with positive margin.

singular_features.description: Strain concentration at the edge of the smooth circular hole. This is the binding state for validity. It is a concentration, not a singularity, because the hole has no corners.
singular_features.quote: the binding state is the transverse strain at the hole edge.

singular_features.description: Point constraints: three displacement components fixed at the hole. The load is self-equilibrated, so nominal reactions are zero and no point-load singularity is expected. Inferred from the boundary conditions.
singular_features.quote: three displacement components at the hole are fixed to remove the rigid motions of the balanced load

Synthetic data come from a nonlinear law psi† fitted to the shear and transverse-compression curves of [49]; its nonlinear part is 40% of the shear strain at failure. The unknown energy psi(e11,e22,gamma12) is restricted to the strain box Omega_c = [-1.175,1.38]% x [-2.0,0.436]% x [-2,2]% and must be even in shear, have a natural state at zero strain and be convex on Omega_c.
Boundary conditions: The boundary carries self-equilibrated tractions (see loading). Three displacement components at the hole are fixed to remove rigid-body motions. The section does not say which nodes or components are fixed.
Loading: Boundary tractions of a homogeneous uniaxial stress along the long axis with resultant P. The load is normalised by PD = 1792 N, the load at which the plate with law psi† first reaches the boundary of Omega_c. Results are reported at 0.6PD (Table 6), at 0.8PD (validity and coupon acquisition), over the load path (Fig. 10a), and at 0.3PD = 537.6 N for the certificate.
Discretisation in the paper: 4096 isoparametric quadratic triangles (P2) on a mapped mesh with 64 divisions around the hole and 32 radially, graded towards the hole; 8320 nodes; 7-point degree-5 quadrature (28 672 quadrature points). The law space uses polynomials of total degree at most 14 in the scaled strains (dimension 680). The section studies only the law-space degree (10/14/16), not the mesh.
